description: This is a Java interface defining the CountryService for managing Country entities, including methods for retrieving countries by code, adding descriptions, and fetching country lists or maps, in the context of a sales management system.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Java interface for country-related business operations in the system.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Country entity based on its code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a specific country.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries filtered by language.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of country codes to Country entities based on language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries based on ISO codes and language.
